pluginDescription: Chooses which operator should start an autocall when multiple operators match the same target in the same slot.
modeDesc: Choose manual operator order or random operator selection.
manualOrderDesc: List operator callsigns in rotation order. If the current next operator is unavailable, the plugin falls through to the next matching candidate in this list.
failAdvanceThresholdDesc: After this many consecutive failures for the same target, the next match advances to the next operator.
avoidImmediateRepeatInRandom: Avoid Immediate Repeat in Random Mode
avoidImmediateRepeatInRandomDesc: When more than one candidate is available, try not to pick the same operator twice in a row.
